anatomy.targetDescription: Illustrative lateral neocortical target on a reference atlas. Not a diagnosed seizure focus or proposed surgical location.
anatomy.attribution: Kristen Browne; Heidi Schlehlein / HuBMAP, CC BY 4.0. HRA Brain Male v1.3 and United Male v1.5, derived display geometry.
anatomy.limitations: Reference atlas, mirrored cerebral structures; no patient anatomy. Skin is registered HRA geometry. Skull/dura are explanatory inward offsets from skin, not segmented bone or meninges. Arachnoid bridges; pia retains local atlas folds. Covering thicknesses, gaps, flaps, window and CSF marker are exaggerated schematic choices. Surrounding head transparency reveals context; this is not medical imaging. Placement above or below dura remains unresolved. Peeling is an educational reveal, not a surgical sequence. The 1D thermal model predicts no lateral field or affected volume.
